turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Watch me first.
I look at "egg". I say it: "e-gg". The first sound is a vowel sound. So: I eat an egg.
Rule: an comes before a vowel sound; a comes before a consonant sound.
Right: I eat a cake.
Wrong: I eat an cake.

Now you. Write only one word:
Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
